sources.expression: the backbone of a child's future

brief.meaningEn: A central supporting element of an ongoing practice, ordinary life or future opportunity: for example, a staple food, dependable neighbours, home infrastructure or sustained education.
brief.meaningZh: 日常活動、生活或未來機會的核心支柱，例如主糧、可靠的鄰里支持、家居設施或持續教育。
brief.grammar: Be/remain/form the backbone of + supported domain. The source also uses the backbone of a child’s future for education as a main support for later opportunities, without claiming it is the only influence.
brief.register: Neutral metaphor for central support: a resident may explain a dependable household or community resource, while a parent may describe the lasting role of education in a child’s opportunities.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有持續而重要的支持作用，不等於唯一來源；教育能支持未來機會，不保證單靠教育就一定成功。
brief.misconceptionZh: 核心支持不表示其他因素無用；不能因一次受歡迎便稱某物為支柱，也不能說教育獨自決定孩子的未來。
brief.outcomeZh: 能辨別日常生活、飲食或未來機會的核心支持，並保留其他因素的作用。

listening.en: In this village, rice remains the backbone of local eating habits because most everyday meals are planned around it.
listening.zh: 在這個村落，平常大部分飯餐都以米飯為中心，所以它仍是本地飲食的核心支柱。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: Rice has a central place in everyday meal planning.
options.zh: 米飯在平日飲食安排中有核心地位。

options.en: Villagers eat rice only at the annual feast.
options.zh: 村民只在年度宴會才吃米飯。

options.en: The sentence says villagers eat no other food.
options.zh: 句子說村民完全不吃其他食物。

options.en: Rice is a newly tried dish that has not become a habit.
options.zh: 米飯只是剛試過、尚未成習慣的新菜式。

listening.explanationZh: most everyday meals 支持中心地位，但 most 不等於只能吃米飯。

reply.promptEn: Why does the village food guide begin with rice?
reply.promptZh: 村落飲食指南為甚麼從米飯開始？

options.en: Rice is the backbone of local eating habits here.
options.zh: 米飯是這裏本地飲食的核心支柱。

options.en: Most everyday meals are organised around it.
options.zh: 平常大部分飯餐都圍繞它安排。

options.en: It provides a useful starting point for explaining common meals.
options.zh: 它是解釋常見飯餐的有用起點。

options.en: Many of the side dishes are usually served with it.
options.zh: 很多配菜通常都與它一起供應。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 某社區的家長指出，持續教育幫助孩子建立讀寫與思考能力，為日後的學習和工作選擇提供主要支持；他們也重視家庭和健康的作用。哪句最貼切？

options.en: They regard sustained education as the backbone of a child’s future, alongside family and health support.
options.zh: 他們視持續教育為孩子未來的核心支柱，同時也重視家庭與健康的支持。

options.en: Because family support matters too, education cannot be a central support for the child’s future.
options.zh: 既然家庭支持也重要，教育就不可能是孩子未來的核心支柱。

options.en: They treat education as sufficient on its own for the child’s later choices, even without family or health support.
options.zh: 他們認為教育單靠自己已足以支持孩子日後的選擇，毋須家庭或健康方面的支持。

scene.explanationZh: 持續教育提供重要的讀寫與思考能力，但不排除家庭、健康等其他支持，也不保證未來結果。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項證據最不足以支持 the backbone of local eating habits？

options.en: Long-term observation shows that everyday meals centre on that staple.
options.zh: 長期觀察顯示平常飯餐多以該主食為中心。

options.en: Visitors liked a new dessert at one tasting, with no evidence of regular use.
options.zh: 一場試食會有人喜歡一道新甜品，但未見日常食用情況。

options.en: Household interviews repeatedly cite the staple as a basis for meal planning.
options.zh: 家庭訪問反覆提到該主食是安排飯餐的基礎。

contrast.explanationZh: 一次活動的喜愛，未建立日常飲食中心地位。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友把一次人氣甜品直接稱為本地飲食支柱。哪句提醒準確？

options.en: To call it the backbone of local eating habits, check its role in ordinary meals over time.
options.zh: 要稱它為本地飲食核心支柱，應查看它長期在平常飯餐中的角色。

options.en: Use the queue at one tasting event as the main evidence of its everyday role.
options.zh: 主要用一次試食會的人龍，證明它的日常角色。

options.en: Rank the dishes by their prices before checking how often households eat them.
options.zh: 先按價格排菜式，再查看家庭多久吃一次。

dialogue.explanationZh: 核心支柱涉及平日安排及持續地位，不只一次人氣或價格。

speaking.en: Rice is the backbone of local eating habits in this village.
speaking.zh: 米飯是這個村落本地飲食的核心支柱。
speaking.promptZh: 你想形容觀察到的日常主食角色。先聽，再說一句。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：虛構小鎮的博物館介紹把年度節慶甜點寫成日常主食；訪問卻顯示家庭平日大多吃麵。你要更正文案，用一至兩句英文說明真正核心。

examples.en: Noodles, rather than the festival sweet, are the backbone of local eating habits in this fictional town. The museum text should reflect everyday meals.
examples.zh: 在這虛構小鎮，麵而非節慶甜點才是本地飲食核心支柱。博物館文案應反映平日飯餐。

examples.en: Our interviews suggest that noodles are the backbone of local eating habits. We should not confuse a yearly treat with an everyday staple.
examples.zh: 訪問顯示麵是本地飲食核心支柱。我們不應混淆年度食品與日常主食。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用日常主食與年度食品的差別更正文案，以虛構小鎮訪問為依據。

takeaways.en: Rice remains the backbone of local eating habits in the village.
takeaways.zh: 米飯仍是該村落本地飲食的核心支柱。

takeaways.en: Shared broadband is the backbone of modern home life in the village: families use it for appointments, homework and bills.
takeaways.zh: 在這村落，共用寬頻是現代家居生活的核心支柱：各家用它預約服務、做功課和繳費。

brief.meaningEn: Travel between two places, especially when discussing the practical journey.
brief.meaningZh: 從一個地方前往另一個地方，重點是實際行程。
brief.grammar: Getting/get/gets/got from A to B or from one place to another describes travel between locations; A and B stand for places, not named people.
brief.register: Neutral shorthand for travel logistics; A and B stand for places, not named people. A commuter may tell a visitor that getting from A to B is easier with the new bus connection.
brief.boundaryZh: 須談論兩地之間如何移動；不是比較選項 A 和 B 的文字標籤。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 A 和 B 當成必須叫這兩個字母的地名。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用這個片語討論路線、轉乘與出行難易。

sources.sentence: The new route makes getting from A to B much easier.

listening.en: The new bus route cuts out a transfer, so getting from A to B across town is much easier now.
listening.zh: 新巴士路線省卻一次轉乘，所以現在穿越市區，從一處到另一處容易得多。

options.en: It makes travelling between places simpler.
options.zh: 它令兩地之間的出行較簡單。

options.en: It mainly lowers the fare without changing the route.
options.zh: 它主要降低車費，卻沒有改變路線。

options.en: It shortens the wait but keeps the same transfer.
options.zh: 它縮短等車時間，但轉乘次數不變。

options.en: It adds an extra transfer across town.
options.zh: 它令穿越市區的旅程多一次轉乘。

listening.explanationZh: 新路線省卻一次轉乘，令兩地之間的旅程更容易；沒有資料顯示車費或候車時間改變。

reply.promptEn: What would help visitors travel between the two exhibition buildings?
reply.promptZh: （甚麼能幫助訪客從一座展覽大樓前往另一座？）

options.en: A clear map would make getting from A to B easier.
options.zh: 清晰的地圖會令訪客從一座大樓前往另一座更容易。

options.en: A short shuttle would save them a long walk.
options.zh: 短程接駁車能省卻漫長步行。

options.en: Signs at both exits would point them the right way.
options.zh: 兩邊出口的指示牌能指引正確方向。

options.en: Staff could explain which walkway connects the two buildings.
options.zh: 職員可以解釋哪條行人通道連接兩座大樓。

reply.explanationZh: 四項都能幫助訪客從一座大樓前往另一座；金句使用本課片語，概括從起點到終點的旅程。

scene.promptZh: 兩座場館原本要轉乘兩次。主辦方增設直達接駁車。哪句最準確描述改動的作用？

options.en: The shuttle makes getting from A to B more straightforward.
options.zh: 接駁車令從一座場館前往另一座更直接。

options.en: Visitors now need two additional transfers to reach the second venue.
options.zh: 訪客現在要額外轉乘兩次，才能到第二個場館。

options.en: Visitors still need to change vehicles twice, though the fare is lower.
options.zh: 訪客仍須轉乘兩次，只是車費較低。

scene.explanationZh: 直達接駁車減少轉乘，改善實際交通；另外兩句都聲稱仍要轉車，與情境不符。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「兩地之間的實際行程」的意思，哪個情況最不適合說 getting from A to B？

options.en: A cyclist asks which bridge connects the two districts.
options.zh: 單車騎士查問哪座橋連接兩個地區。

options.en: A teacher compares answer choice A with answer choice B on a worksheet.
options.zh: 老師比較工作紙上的 A 和 B 兩個答案選項。

options.en: A traveller checks how long it takes to reach the harbour from the station.
options.zh: 旅客查問從車站到碼頭需時多久。

contrast.explanationZh: 比較工作紙的答案選項不涉及前往兩地；另外兩項都是路線或交通問題。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「車站與音樂廳相隔兩條街，但我不熟悉這一帶。這張地圖標了行人過路處。」哪個回應最有幫助？

options.en: To get from one place to another on foot, use the marked crossing shown on this map.
options.zh: 要步行從車站到音樂廳，可使用這張地圖標示的行人過路處。

options.en: The nearest side street should be quickest, so take it without checking where the crossing is.
options.zh: 最近的側街應該最快；不用查看行人過路處在哪裏，走那邊就好。

options.en: The hall is only two streets away, so head straight towards it even if that misses the marked crossing.
options.zh: 音樂廳只隔兩條街，朝它直走就好，即使這樣會錯過地圖標示的行人過路處。

dialogue.explanationZh: 地圖標示的行人過路處提供可核查的步行路線；其餘回應只憑距離或側街位置猜測，沒有確認過路位置。

speaking.en: A simple walking map made getting from A to B easier for new visitors.
speaking.zh: 簡單的步行地圖讓初次到訪的人更容易從起點走到目的地。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明步行地圖怎樣幫助初次到訪的人。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校活動分別在主校舍與體育館舉行，新同學不懂兩地之間怎樣走。用一至兩句英文介紹你會提供甚麼幫助。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明兩地之間的出行問題，以及地圖或指示牌等具體幫助；不要只談論課室名稱。

examples.en: A marked map will make getting from A to B easier for new students. We can show the safest crossing.
examples.zh: 有標記的地圖會令新同學從主校舍前往體育館更容易。我們可以指出最安全的行人過路處。

examples.en: Getting from A to B can be confusing for new students, so I will put clear signs beside both entrances.
examples.zh: 新同學可能不清楚怎樣從主校舍前往體育館，所以我會在兩邊入口旁放置清晰的指示牌。

takeaways.en: Getting from A to B took longer when the footbridge was closed.
takeaways.zh: 行人天橋關閉後，從一處前往另一處要更久。

takeaways.en: The guide explained how to get from A to B without changing trains.
takeaways.zh: 導遊解釋了如何不轉車便從一處到另一處。
